short_summary: Seshego (19 combos) and Superbia (11 combos): the discovery crawler returned 112 candidates across all 30 combos and every single one was unusable -- national chains/head offices, generic category or dictionary pages, directory aggregator homepages, or content with no relation to the business at all (Netflix help forums, lottery sites, acne medical pages, gambling sites). None named a business actually trading in Seshego or Superbia with a suburb-specific phone and address. Re-ran targeted one-off searches (shopping-centre tenant lists, suburb+category phrasing, Bing in place of Brave) for the most promising categories (funeral services, security, printing, panel beaters, guest houses, attorneys) and still found nothing suburb-specific -- results stayed generic/national or drifted off-topic. 0 businesses added; all 30 combos remain short of 3.
